text.p: Earthgrains Co said it acquired bagel maker H & L Baking Co of Albuquerque, N.M.
H & L, which operates one plant, has co-packed Earthgrain's packaged shelf-stable premium bagels since 1996 when the product was fully introduced across the company's U.S. bakery products territory.
Earthgrains said it also will expand its Fort Payne, Ala., bakery's bagel production line to help meet increasing demand.

"Our bagels have been an outstanding new product success, and we expect to continue to increase our market share in this growing product segment," John Iselin Jr., U.S. bakery products president, said in a statement.
Earthgrains said its Earth Grains-brand shelf-stable bagels have captured more than 15 percent of the bagel market served by the company.
